recipe.name: Broad Street Irish Coffee
directions: Shake the whisky, coffee, syrup and bitters together in a shaker with 1 cube of ice. Strain into a Collins glass over fresh ice. Top with the whipped cream.

Bénédictine Whipped CreamPlace 4 oz. of heavy cream, 1 oz. of Bénédictine, and 1/2 oz. of simple syrup in a mixing tin and whip by hand until light and fluffy. Alternatively, place all 3 ingredients in a blender and lightly pulse until the cream becomes fluffy.
